answer: By the yarrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The haven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lotus is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
